# MY PG - PG Management Software
> India's leading SaaS platform for Paying Guest (PG) accommodation management, serving 5000+ property owners across Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad, and Pune. The platform automates rent collection, tenant onboarding, room occupancy tracking, and financial reporting for the co-living industry.

## Core Product
- **MY PG Web Application**: Cloud-based property management system accessible via desktop and mobile browsers
- **Automated Rent Collection**: Integrated UPI, net banking, and card payments with automated reminder workflows
- **Tenant Management**: Digital KYC verification, automated lease agreements, and tenant communication portal
- **Occupancy Tracking**: Real-time room availability dashboard with waitlist management and predictive analytics
- **Financial Reporting**: Automated P&L statements, expense categorization, and tax-ready documentation

## Key Features
- Multi-property dashboard for portfolio management across cities
- Automated invoice generation and payment tracking with late fee calculation
- WhatsApp Business API integration for tenant communications
- Maintenance request ticketing system with vendor assignment
- Digital document vault for agreements, KYC, and compliance records
- Mobile-responsive interface optimized for property manager workflows

## Use Cases
- **Individual PG Owners**: Single property management with 10-50 beds requiring automation
- **PG Chains**: Multi-location operators requiring centralized oversight and standardized reporting
- **Hostel Management**: Budget accommodation and co-living space operators
- **Real Estate Investors**: Portfolio tracking, ROI analysis, and property valuation support
